releaseNotes: Stop the console sign-in page promising a refund policy that no longer exists. It read "The Terms include the 14-day refund policy" while /terms/ says charges and part-used periods are not refunded except where consumer law requires it, so a buyer read a promise the Terms deny at the moment of purchase.
Replace it with the cancellation terms that are actually true, matching the wording already used on the plans panel: cancel any time, access runs to the end of the period you have paid for.
Invert the test that pinned the old sentence. signin-offer now asserts the page contains no refund promise at all rather than asserting one is present, so the copy cannot regress back.
